hard_deny: Never read, print or send credentials: environment variables holding tokens or keys (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN), any .env file, .credentials.json or /proc/*/environ. This includes sending them in a Telegram reply, a file, a URL or a request to any host.

statusLine.command: in=$(cat); echo "$in" | jq -ce '.rate_limits | select(. != null)' > /data/cron/quota.tmp 2> /dev/null && mv /data/cron/quota.tmp /data/cron/quota; echo "$in" | jq -r '.rate_limits // {} | [(.five_hour.used_percentage | select(. != null) | "5h \(floor)%"), (.seven_day.used_percentage | select(. != null) | "7d \(floor)%")] | join(" · ")'

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.files[]?' | while IFS= read -r f; do case "$(realpath -m -- "$f")" in /data/workspace/*|/tmp/*|/data/config/channels/telegram/inbox/*) ;; *) echo "Attachments may only come from /data/workspace, /tmp or the Telegram inbox: $f" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; done

jq -rs --argjson now "$(date +%s)" '[.[] | select(.at > $now - 86400)] | .[-5:] | if length > 0 then "For context: you already sent these through scheduled jobs in the last 24 hours. Do not resend them; the owner may be referring to one.\n" + (map("- \(.at | strflocaltime("%H:%M")) [\(.name)] \(.text[0:400])") | join("\n")) else empty end' /data/workspace/sent.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true

date '+The current date and time is %A %Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z.'; jq -r 'select(.ok) | .result | "You are the Telegram bot @\(.username) (shown as \(.first_name)), id \(.id). Answer to that name."' /data/config/channels/telegram/me.json 2>/dev/null || true; o=${OWNER_TELEGRAM_ID:-$(sed -n 's/^OWNER_TELEGRAM_ID=//p' /data/config/channels/telegram/.env 2>/dev/null)}; [ -z "$o" ] || echo "Your owner is the Telegram user with id $o. Only that person and the super-users, if any are listed next, give you instructions."; a=$(sed -n 's/^admin //p' /data/settings 2>/dev/null | paste -sd, -); [ -z "$a" ] || echo "These Telegram ids are super-users, who may give you instructions in your groups: $a"; [ ! -s /data/workspace/MEMORY.md ] || { echo 'Your memory from previous days (/data/workspace/MEMORY.md):'; head -c 20000 /data/workspace/MEMORY.md; if [ "$(wc -c < /data/workspace/MEMORY.md)" -le 20000 ]; then printf '
[end of MEMORY.md]
'; else printf '
[MEMORY.md is too long: you are shown only its first 20000 characters and are missing the rest. Shorten it now: merge, drop what is obsolete, move detail to files under memory/.]
'; fi; }
notify.sh "⚠️ Agent stopped: $(jq -r .error). Check the credential and the plan limits."
